_comment: The live mainnet deployment. Every value comes from contract/mainnet-deploy-2026-10-21.log and the keeper's run logs contract/mainnet-keeper-run-*.log. `make verify` fails if the README disagrees with this file, if `attested_snapshots` or `resolutions` disagree with the run logs or with site/contract-cache.json, or if a local `make wasm` / `make worker` build differs from the hashes below; `make verify-deploy` compares them (including each snapshot, resolution and its transaction) with the chain and rebuilds the contract reproducibly from source_commit. The earlier testnet deployment: contract/deployment-testnet.json.
build: cargo near build reproducible-wasm (host cargo-near 0.22.0; image sourcescan/cargo-near:0.21.1-rust-1.96.0)
owner_full_access_key: still on the contract account; to be deleted before submission, which freezes the code
transactions: Create nearbooks.near (3 NEAR, near.create_account, from the deployer)
Upload the worker to FastFS (receiver outlayer.near)
Deploy the reproducible build + new(owner = reporter = nearbooks.near, pin_delay_secs = 86400)
First pin (applies at once, event worker_pinned)
Deployer sends 0.35 NEAR to nearbooks.near (pays for the keeper account)
Add a function-call key (allowance 0.25 NEAR; later replaced)
Deployer sends 0.4 NEAR to the keeper (a 300 Tgas call needs about 0.3 NEAR of balance and allowance up front)
Add the keeper's function-call key (allowance 1 NEAR; this contract; keeper_request_snapshot, resolve_prediction)
keeper/keeper.py run 2026-10-21: keeper_request_snapshot(2026-10-21, 220871336, 216835292) signed by the function-call key: stored, OutLayer request 2565
